title: Ars Mekanica
description: Bridges Ars Nouveau and Mekanism for tighter cross-mod integration. Currently adds Mekanism sawmill support for archwood, with more to come.
body:
# Ars Mekanica

  A compatibility addon that bridges **Ars Nouveau** and **Mekanism**, letting their
  content work better together. This is the first step, with more integrations planned
  for future versions.

  Right now it fills an obvious gap: Ars Nouveau's archwood comes with a full set of
  wooden items, but Mekanism ships no sawmill recipes for it - so archwood logs are a
  dead end in a Mekanism setup. Ars Mekanica adds the missing **Precision Sawmill**
  recipes so archwood behaves exactly like vanilla wood.

  ## What it adds

  Precision Sawmill recipes for archwood, mirroring Mekanism's vanilla wood ratios:

  - Archwood logs / wood / stripped variants → archwood planks (+ sawdust)
  - Archwood doors, trapdoors, fences, fence gates, pressure plates, buttons, slabs,
    stairs, signs, hanging signs, boats and chests → archwood planks

**Source Dynamo** — a block that converts Ars Nouveau Source into Forge Energy for Mekanism machines. Place it between a Source Jar and a power consumer; every balance value is configurable.

  ## Requirements

  Both **Ars Nouveau** and **Mekanism** must be installed — Ars Mekanica does nothing
  on its own.

  | Minecraft | Loader            |
  |-----------|-------------------|
  | 1.21.1    | NeoForge          |
  | 1.20.1    | Forge / NeoForge  |

  Prefer not to add another mod? A standalone **datapack** build is also available.

  ## Planned
Depending on interest, later versions may add deeper Source <-> Mekanism chemical integration or other cross-mod compat. Nothing promised yet.
